title: Deterministic stage work budget
statement: Let the output dimension be a positive integer $n$, let the requested bias be a positive rational number at most $1/2$, and let the integral Fourier $1$-norm bound be an integer at least $1$. Define the stage work budget as the controller’s step work at the input threshold, plus the stage query budget, plus twice the product of the active-set cap at that threshold and the restricted-weight local work.
hypotheses_covered: Positive rational bias encoded by a positive numerator and denominator
Encoded bias at most one half
caveat: The input threshold, controller step work, active-set cap, stage query budget, and restricted-weight local work are referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
